description: Requires signing in to GearHost. Publish/update content to a CloudSite ALREADY in the user's GearHost account (by domain). To put a NEW site online, use publish_website instead: it needs no account. Provide ONE of: html, files map (must include index.html at the root), or zip_base64. Returns structuredContent { status, url, domain, files, updated }.

domain.description: The CloudSite domain to publish to (must be in your account).

files.description: Map of relative path => contents. MUST include "index.html" at the root.

html.description: HTML for a one-page site (served as index.html at the root).

zip_base64.description: Base64 .zip with index.html at the archive root.

name: publish_to_my_site
title: Publish to my site
